meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞曲：Helen H. Lemmel (Public Domain)、周巽光、謝思穎、許書珩
中譯英：王建玫

lines.a: 當轉眼仰望耶穌
lines.b: Turn your eyes upon Jesus

lines.a: 定睛在祂奇妙慈容
lines.b: Look full in His wonderful face

lines.a: 在救主榮耀恩典大光中
lines.b: And the things of earth will grow strangely dim

lines.a: 世上事必然變為虛空
lines.b: In the light of His glory and grace

lines.a: 我的心無助徬徨
lines.b: All my heart is lost and torn

lines.a: 已用盡所有方法
lines.b: I have tried out every way

lines.a: 但我聽見救主耶穌 來到我的身旁
lines.b: But I hear my Savior Jesus coming right by my side

lines.a: 我躲在人群中間
lines.b: Hiding deep inside the crowd

lines.a: 只想掩飾我不潔
lines.b: Trying hard to hide my shame

lines.a: 祢醫治的恩典引導我來到祢面前
lines.b: Your healing grace is leading me to call upon Your name

lines.a: 呼喚我的名 吸引我靠近
lines.b: Calling out my name, drawing me so close

lines.a: 我需要祢大能 滲透我身體
lines.b: I need Your great mighty power, flowing through my veins

lines.a: 沉浸祢愛裡 我心就堅定
lines.b: Soaking in Your love, my heart is secure

lines.a: 我呼求祢掌權 在我的生命
lines.b: I cry out for You to reign in my life today

lines.a: 使我甦醒轉眼仰望 祢熾熱的眼睛
lines.b: Waken my heart to look upon You, Your blazing eyes of deep love

lines.a: 像光穿透我靈 挪走所有恐懼
lines.b: Piercing my spirit right through, taking away all my fear Jesus

lines.a: 祢的愛恢復我心
lines.b: Your love restores my heart

lines.a: 凝視著我向我吹氣 如雨滋潤我生命
lines.b: As You gaze at me, breathing Your life, just like the rain on my dry soul

lines.a: 醫治我的疾病 使我全然更新
lines.b: Healing every single pain, making me completely whole Jesus

lines.a: 祢的愛永無止盡
lines.b: Your love will never end

lines.a: 醫治我的疾病 使我全然更新
lines.b: Healing every single pain, making me completely whole Jesus

lines.a: 祢的愛永無止盡
lines.b: Your love will never end
